findings.title: Watchdog does not create the caller-owned collector environment parent
findings.mechanism: After request-manifest.json and owner/watchdog/target accounting, watchdog calls environment(capture/collector-env). That parent is absent and no prior caller creates it. The pinned helper uses non-recursive mkdir for its first child collector-env/tmp, so it raises FileNotFoundError before collector Popen at watchdog.py:122.
